notes: Piece counts match the parts list: 235 pieces. The 3 minifigures (heads, helmets, visors, torsos, legs) are not in the parts list, so they are not recorded.

Page 3 builds the stretcher (b1-b3) as its own small model, and no numbered step attaches it to the helicopter. I joined the winch cord (b165) to the stretcher (b1) only because the box cover shows it hanging from the cord. That join is an assumption, not a booklet step.

Ids follow the booklet order, with the stretcher from page 3 first. After the stretcher come the lower hull, cockpit, rear sub-assembly, tail boom, engine cover, winch, the two hatches, landing gear, rotor and sticker sheet.

Pieces built as sub-assemblies (winch, hatches, tail, engine cover, landing gear) list rests_on against the model pieces they sit on once attached. This sometimes refers to a lower id than the sub-assembly was built from.

The underside plates added in steps 5-6 and the landing gear attached from below in step 32 are drawn from below in the booklet. I recorded them as clutching the hull plate above them where the booklet is clear, and with an other_join for the landing gear.
Both white boxes (4345b plus door 4346 plus a 1x2 handle plate) are listed together at step 16, although the booklet only shows one being built. The second box is on the far side of the helicopter.

The small renders are ambiguous for several pieces, so these placements are assumptions: the 4070 headlight cones, the saw and bag clipped to the clip tile in the rear sub-assembly, the lamps (3959), the binoculars used as a wheel peg on the 4488 holders, the door rail inside the first box, and the exact stud-to-stud contacts for plates stacked on top of each other.
The tyres are recorded as joined to their wheels. The string is recorded as wound on the drum and tied through the hook.
